DELIVERY_STATUS_INVALID: status accepts only failed or delivered
DLQ_BODY_UNAVAILABLE: This failed record did not save the message body, so it cannot be replayed
DLQ_NOT_FAILED: This delivery record is not in a failed state; nothing to replay
FOREACH_COLLECT_MISSING: The collect node produced no output; skipping collection for this iteration
LLM_CLASSIFIER_UNAVAILABLE: No LLM classifier is configured in production; the condition node aborted this run instead of silently taking the default branch
LLM_DECISION_UNAVAILABLE: No LLM decision provider is configured in production; the AI decision node aborted this run instead of silently falling back to rules
LOOP_ITEMS_TOO_LARGE: The iterated array exceeds the maximum length
LOOP_MAX_ITERATIONS: Reached the maximum number of iterations; exiting the loop
OPENAPI_BODY_MISSING_SCHEMA: The request body is missing a JSON schema

OPENAPI_DOCUMENT_SERVER_URL_NOT_ABSOLUTE: servers[0].url must be an absolute URL including the host
OPENAPI_DOCUMENT_SOURCE_EXCLUSIVE: Exactly one of content or url must be provided
OPENAPI_FETCH_HTTP_ERROR: Failed to fetch the spec: HTTP {{status}}
OPENAPI_KEYWORD_ONEOF: The keyword oneOf is not supported
OPENAPI_NO_IMPORTABLE_OPERATION: No importable operations (every operation in the document was skipped)
OPENAPI_PARAM_MISSING_NAME_IN: The parameter is missing a valid name/in
OPENAPI_PARAM_MISSING_SCHEMA: Parameter {{name}} is missing a JSON schema
OPENAPI_PARAM_NOT_OBJECT: The parameter must be an object
OPENAPI_PARAM_REF_NOT_OBJECT: The parameter $ref target must be an object
OPENAPI_REF_EXTERNAL: External $ref is not supported (only #/components refs in this document)
OPENAPI_RESTORE_CLASH: The restored spec duplicates an existing (not deleted) spec
OPENAPI_SPEC_OPERATIONS_LIMIT: A single spec may contain at most {{max}} operations
